[[File:EYAkhDesert-AOTC.jpg|thumb|300px|[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] is chased across the E'Y-Akh Desert.]]
The '''E'Y-Akh Desert''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], close to the main battlefields of the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]].

A [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Republic gunship]] holding [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] chased [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] on the other side of the [[Desert/Legends|desert]], where he had hidden his [[Solar sailer/Legends|solar sailer]]. During the chase, Amidala and a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] were knocked off the gunship and into the desert below.

[[San Hill/Legends|San Hill's]] [[Hardcell-class interstellar transport/Legends|''Hardcell'']] transport was stranded here without thrusters. Even so, he eventually managed to escape from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].

The [[Stalgasin hive/Legends|Stalgasin hive]] was located within the boundaries of the desert. Every [[Standard year/Legends|year]], heavy rainfall swept across the desert and overflowed the underground aquifers. This worked out to the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]]' advantage, as the subsequent flood killed herds of [[Merdeth/Legends|merdeths]] which they could then use for food. Merdeth shells littered the desert and polished the sand.
